title: Crunchy Parmesan Crumble Chicken Breasts
description: A delicious and easy-to-make chicken dish topped with a crunchy parmesan crumble, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 cup crumble
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup each of light and reggiano

instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breasts and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the crumble, parmesan, and garlic.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the chicken breasts.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the crumble is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
